other_conditions: Must be a registered worker of the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of West Bengal
Must have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year
Application must be made by a nominee of a deceased registered member
The deceased member must have died (natural or accidental)
benefits_summary: Provides ₹50,000 for natural death and ₹150,000 for accidental death to the nominee of a deceased registered worker.
